retrieved.text: By default, dialogs are auto-dismissed by Playwright, so you don't have to handle them. However, you can register a dialog handler before the action that triggers the dialog to either dialog.accept() or dialog.dismiss() it. ```js page.on('dialog', dialog => dialog.accept()); await page.getByRole('button').click(); ``` the 'dialog' event listener **must handle** the dialog.
